purpose: Second-pass artisan gap fill for Construction/Cooking/Crafting after training-gap-artisan-2026-07-26.json was merged into catalog.json. Only methods still missing as standalone training rows are recorded; exact catalog duplicates (contracts, prawnbrokers, harps Con side-XP, Fort T3 kitchen bonfire, Menaphos cook, dairy churn, Bait and Switch, Ithell harps Crafting, Iaia tannery, Gate moonstones, crafteneering, gem/necklace porter loop) are skipped.

methods.location: Sawmill (planks/frames) then POH workshop workbench flatpacks; mahogany planks via sawmill operator (e.g. Bill) from 40 Construction without needing 60 Con to process logs
methods.notes: Ironman guide ladder: 1-10 normal planks (+ refined planks / wooden frames for Fort); 10-19 oak planks/frames; 19-32 oak chair flatpacks; 32-35 carved oak table; 35-38 teak armchair/table/bench; 40-52 mahogany bookcase flatpacks; 52-63 mahogany table flatpacks. Portable workbenches unusable on Ironman. At 60+ Construction Contracts are the preferred AFK path (already catalogued).
methods.warning: No per-hour XP published on the ironman Construction guide for this ladder; rates are material- and banking-route dependent.

methods.level_range: supply method (Throne of Miscellania + Royal Trouble early); feeds teak/mahogany contracts and Fort maple/hardwood buildings
methods.intensity: passive kingdom collect; zero active Construction XP until planks are used
methods.location: Miscellania / Etceteria kingdom workers on hardwood (10 subjects recommended)
methods.notes: Primary ironman teak/mahogany log pipeline for Construction. Teak planks worth 90 Con XP each and mahogany 140 Con XP each when used in furniture. Without Miscellania, need ~60 Woodcutting for self-chop mahogany. Maple workers also feed Fort maple-building repeats (70-80).
methods.warning: This is a material supply row, not a pure Construction XP method. Requires Fremennik quest access path (Throne of Miscellania / Royal Trouble).

methods.level_range: any when converting logs with coins; House Teleport for bank-free loop
methods.intensity: active coin+log conversion; very fast with house at Rimmington
methods.location: Plank maker north of Rimmington POH portal; set house location to Rimmington
methods.notes: Ironman guide Obtaining planks: pay logs + coins at the Rimmington plank maker next to the house portal. Moving the house to Rimmington and using House Teleport makes conversion very quick. Complements Miscellania hardwood and self-made sawmill planks. Sawmill self-make is free but slower AFK Con XP while consuming Construction levels per plank tier.
methods.warning: Costs coins per plank; no published XP/h (supply conversion, not training).

methods.level_range: 44 Construction to wear; Temple Trekking NPC total levels for pieces (hat 200 / trousers 300 / garb 400 combined; gloves Pazuzu 85; boots Zachory Bragg 25)
methods.xp_rate: 6% Construction XP with full five-piece set (1% per piece + 1% set); stacks with Sculpting chisel to 7%
methods.intensity: minigame unlock grind, then passive XP amplifier on all Construction
methods.location: Temple Trekking / Burgh de Rott Ramble noticeboard rewards (Morytania)
methods.notes: Permanent ironman Construction XP set called out on Construction Contracts setup. Requires In Aid of the Myreque to trek; Darkness of Hallowvale for garb total-level threshold. Also applies to long/curved bone turn-ins at Barlak. Regional-skilling already lists Temple Trekking outfits; this row is the Construction training dependency so planners treat Morytania as outfit acquisition, not only combat/slayer.
methods.warning: Not a standalone XP method. Vic the trader (Burthorpe) was a historical alternate purchase path — do not treat Treasure Hunter as the League acquisition route.

methods.method: Rogues' Den permanent fire bank loop
methods.intensity: low-click bank-to-fire loop (pre-built fire, no logs)
methods.location: Rogues' Den under the Pick and Lute, south-west Taverley — permanently lit fire a few tiles from a bank
methods.notes: Ironman Cooking Locations: best zero-requirement permanent fire when not maintaining a player bonfire. Pre-built fires (Rogues' Den, Prif Tower of Voices, Menaphos, Yeti Town, Max Guild) do NOT grant the +10% player-bonfire bonus. Optimal XP remains player bonfire + Fort Forinthry tier-3 kitchen (+10% and +5% stacking) already catalogued under misthalin working taxonomy.
methods.warning: No XP/h on the ironman guide for this site; use as convenience/AFK cook location, not the rate ceiling.

methods.method: Sous chef's outfit (Gnome Restaurant hard deliveries)
methods.level_range: Gnome Restaurant hard deliveries; no Cooking level gate on the outfit itself
methods.xp_rate: 6% Cooking XP with full five-piece set (1% per piece + 1% set); stacks with player bonfire boost
methods.intensity: minigame unlock grind, then passive XP amplifier
methods.location: Gnome Restaurant hard deliveries (Tree Gnome Stronghold / Kandarin)
methods.notes: Ironman Cooking Important equipment: sequential common hard-delivery rewards. Cooking gauntlets substitute for mitts set-bonus if mitts owned (wear gauntlets). With dairy churn + both PoF farm totems (quad XP) + full sous chef, ironman guide cites upwards of ~215k Cooking XP/h. Regional-skilling already surfaces the outfit under Kandarin; this row is the Cooking training dependency for no-trading League planning.
methods.warning: Do not use Treasure Hunter as acquisition path (outfits removed from TH). Effect is global after unlock; Kandarin is the hard gameplay source region.
